body:
## What

Closes the biggest qt4tests cluster: the three F&O 4.0 §17.5 CSV functions land at the **frozen `XPath40` level** (not experimental), plus two parser companions and a harness upgrade.

**New surfaces (4.0-only; XPST0017 at 3.1):**
- `fn:parse-csv($value[, $options])` → 4-entry record map (`columns`/`column-index`/`rows`/`get`). Raw-row discipline: CR/CRLF normalized up front; comments at raw row start; blank rows only when newline-terminated; quote opens only as first field char; doubled-quote escape; closing quote must be followed by sep/newline/EOF (FOCV0001); trim-rows width captured before header consumption; select-columns reorders/dups/pads and beats trim-rows.
- `fn:csv-to-xml($value[, $options])` → §17.5.9 element shape.
- `fn:csv-doc($href[, $options])` → unparsed-text path (FOUT1200 on invalid BOM incl. FF FF) + parse.
- Parser companions (4.0-gated, XPST0003 in 3.1): bare `{…}` map constructor (spec PR2778); consecutive for/let FLWOR clauses.

**Harness:** `ResultComparer.AssertCompatibility` lets the shared qt3/qt4 comparer assert at different compatibility levels; qt4 gate gains 3 sets → **207**.

## Gates (all green)

- Release build 0 errors; `dotnet test Bosak.sln -c Release` all green (Standard.Tests 1171, Api.Tests 301, incl. ~50 new `CsvTests`)
- QT3 **31,142/0/679** preserved exactly
- XSLT smoke **162/0/26**
- qt4: fn-parse-csv **124/0/0**, fn-csv-to-xml **68/0/2** (2 skips = XQ40-only deps), fn-csv-doc **20/0/0**; `BOSAK_QT4_GATE_ONLY=1` exit 0 with 207 sets

## Files

- New: `src/Bosak.XPath.Standard/Functions/Csv.cs` (0.1), `tests/Bosak.XPath.Standard.Tests/CsvTests.cs` (0.1)
- FunctionLibrary 5.134 · XPathParser 1.68 · ResultComparer 3.0 · ConformanceRunner40 0.6 · VersionGateTests 0.13
title: feat(req123): fn:parse-csv/fn:csv-to-xml/fn:csv-doc — F&O 4.0 §17.5 CSV functions (frozen XPath40 level)
